title: Mitigating hERG Liability of Toll-Like Receptor 9 and 7 Antagonists through Structure-Based Design.
authors: Das, Nirmal; Bhattacharya, Debomita; Bandopadhyay, Purbita; Dastidar, Uddipta Ghosh; Paul, Barnali; Rahaman, Oindrila; Hoque, Israful; Patra, Binita; Ganguly, Dipyaman; Talukdar, Arindam
one_liner_zh: 该文通过结构导向设计优化TLR7/9拮抗剂的hERG安全性，不涉及蛋白质-DNA互作或TF-DNA结合，与课题无关。
abstract: hERG is considered to be a primary anti-target in the drug development process, as the K(+) channel encoded by hERG plays an important role in cardiac re-polarization. It is desirable to address the hERG safety liability during early-stage development to avoid the expenses of validating leads that will eventually fail at a later stage. We have previously reported the development of highly potent quinazoline-based TLR7 and TLR9 antagonists for possible application against autoimmune disease. Initial experimental hERG assessment showed that most of the lead TLR7 and TLR9 antagonists suffer from hERG liability rendering them ineffective for further development. The present study herein describes a coordinated strategy to integrate the understanding from structure-based protein-ligand interaction to develop non- hERG binders with IC(50) >30 muM with retention of TLR7/9 antagonism through a single point change in the scaffold. This structure-guided strategy can serve as a prototype for abolishing hERG liability during lead optimization.
abstract_zh: hERG被认为是药物开发过程中的主要反靶点，因为由hERG编码的K(+)通道在心脏复极化中扮演重要角色。在早期开发阶段解决hERG安全性问题至关重要，以避免验证最终可能在后期失败的先导化合物所带来的费用。我们此前已报道了高效基于喹唑啉的TLR7和TLR9拮抗剂的开发，这些拮抗剂可能用于自身免疫疾病的治疗。初步实验性hERG评估显示，大多数先导TLR7和TLR9拮抗剂存在hERG风险，使其无法进一步开发。本研究描述了一种协调策略，整合基于结构的蛋白质-配体相互作用理解，通过支架中的单点改变，开发出IC(50) >30 μM的非hERG结合剂，同时保留TLR7/9拮抗活性。这种结构引导策略可作为在先导优化过程中消除hERG风险的范例。
